title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning with a stronger offline learner: TD3+BC on log utility with 10-step returns, both arms
description: expliCCit's offline CQL proved too weak a learner to price the latents' meaning: in exp-lcf-cost-search-316 and exp-lcf-cost-teacher-search-318 both arms under it scored far below their own clones of BBRv3 (-1.20 and -1.84 minus BBRv3, against -0.86 and -0.28), and every RL stage after cloning lowered both arms. A gap between two learners that fail says little about meaning (user, 2026-11-19). Its recipe trains on Sage's reward with one-step TD; this repository's offline recipe (TD3+BC, log utility, 10-step returns) brought expliCCit's actor on neto1 v1 level with BBRv3 on validation (exp-neto2-search2-val-247, +0.04 to +0.06), though with the bdp action. Here both arms keep expliCCit's actor, critic and window multiplier (action_max 1, rounded to three decimals) and only the learner changes: TD3+BC at alpha 2.5, 5 or 10 (the Q term's weight), log utility, 10-step returns, 60,000 or 150,000 updates, training seeds 0 and 1. Arms: paper (neto1 v1's seven values, from exp-net1-point-228), free (an encoder of neto1 v1's architecture from random weights, trained by the critic's loss, on the scaled measurements), and both again from their clones of BBRv3 in exp-lcf-cost-teacher-317 (paperclone; freeclone, its encoder held fixed as in lcft-freefix): 48 policies, lcftd-ARM-aALPHA-nSTEPSk-sSEED. Training only: a later run scores every policy in closed loop on links 0 to 99 and chooses each arm's configuration by its mean over both seeds.
run: N="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; O="$OUT/lcftd-$ARM-a$ALPHA-n$((STEPS / 1000))k-s$SEED"; mkdir -p "$O"; FREE='{}'; T=''; case "$ARM" in free) FREE='{"inputs": "raw", "encoder": "free"}';; paperclone) T="$IN/t/lcft-paper-none-s$SEED/net2.pt";; freeclone) FREE='{"inputs": "raw", "encoder": "free", "encoder_lr": 0}'; T="$IN/t/lcft-freefix-none-s$SEED/net2.pt";; esac; [ -z "$T" ] || [ -f "$T" ]; jq -n --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --arg t "$T" --argjson seed "$SEED" --argjson alpha "$ALPHA" --argjson steps "$STEPS" --argjson free "$FREE" '{data: [$d], split_by: "link", seed: $seed, net1_from: $n, net2: ({algo: "td3bc", action: "multiplier", reward: "log_utility", reward_scale: 1.0, n_step: 10, action_max: 1.0, action_decimals: 3, alpha: $alpha, steps: $steps} + $free)} + (if $t == "" then {} else {net2_from: $t} end)' > "$O/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$O/train.json" "$O"; rm -f "$O/net1.pt"
collect: { echo "| policy | transitions | validation BC error | seconds | final diagnostics |"; echo "|---|---|---|---|---|"; for r in "$OUT"/lcftd-*/report.json; do echo "| $(basename "$(dirname "$r")") | $(jq -r '[.net2.transitions, .net2.val_bc_mse, (.net2.seconds | floor), (.net2.final | to_entries | map("\(.key) \(.value | tostring | .[0:7])") | join(", "))] | join(" | ")' "$r") |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
